purpose: Define MCP capability/tool/resource/prompt advertisements as untrusted descriptive observations that must be normalized and validated before AIGMos runtime use.

topics.name: MCP Capability Advertisement
topics.purpose: Define MCP capability/tool/resource/prompt advertisements as untrusted descriptive observations that must be normalized and validated before AIGMos runtime use.

semantics.source_rule: Advertisement records exact originating MCP endpoint identity.
semantics.schema_rule: Advertised names/descriptions/input schemas/output metadata are captured as source claims.
semantics.trust_rule: Advertisement is descriptive input and not canonical truth or execution authority.
semantics.change_rule: Capability changes across reconnects are explicit observations and never silently rewrite validated tool semantics.
semantics.identity_rule: External advertised name is not automatically canonical #T identity.
semantics.normalization_rule: Advertisement is normalized before compatibility/registration evaluation.
semantics.failure_rule: Malformed/unsupported advertisements remain rejected/unavailable rather than guessed.

invariants.rule: MCP endpoint identity, advertised capability, validated #T tool identity, concrete invocation and returned result are separate identities; advertisement or availability never grants execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: advertisement treated as trusted canonical definition
reconnect silently rewrites validated tool contract

references.purpose: Advertisement provenance binds to exact MCP endpoint.

prose.summary: Define MCP capability/tool/resource/prompt advertisements as untrusted descriptive observations that must be normalized and validated before AIGMos runtime use.
